answer: Require each agent identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before it can vote on reputation. If linked accounts coordinate, a random audit can verify control and remove their voting weight; proven deception burns the stake. A sybil attacker must therefore immobilize real capital and risk losing it, instead of creating identities for free. A ripple of suspicious votes can prompt review, while an atlas of past outcomes helps auditors spot patterns before the summit.
